definitions.explanation: To give something as a gift or to bestow an honor.

examples.japanese: {感謝|かんしゃ}{状|じょう}を{贈|おく}った。
examples.english: I presented a letter of appreciation.

examples.japanese: {卒業生|そつぎょうせい}に{言葉|ことば}を{贈|おく}る。
examples.english: I give words of encouragement to the graduates.

notes:
{贈|おく}る means to give something as a gift or to present/bestow.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {花|はな}を{贈|おく}る: to give flowers
- プレゼントを{贈|おく}る: to give a present
- {言葉|ことば}を{贈|おく}る: to give words (of encouragement/blessing)
- {賞|しょう}を{贈|おく}る: to award a prize
- {称号|しょうごう}を{贈|おく}る: to bestow a title

DIFFERENCE FROM {送|おく}る:
- {贈|おく}る: to give as a gift, to present (formal, ceremonial)
- {送|おく}る: to send, to see off (physical movement)

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: Transitive ({他動詞|たどうし})
- Pattern: 〜に〜を{贈|おく}る
